string.text: Mutant sweep
A dangerous mutant group has been identified. Contract issued by %s (%s). Eliminate the group and return for payment.
We need a mutant infestation cleared. Can you handle it?
The target is eliminated. Well done.
Enemy outpost assault
An enemy encampment has been identified. Contract issued by %s (%s). Clear the marked position and report back.
We need an enemy outpost neutralized.
Outpost cleared. Contract complete.
Target elimination
A contract has been issued to eliminate a target. Client: %s (%s). Target details will be provided once you accept.
A specific hostile stalker needs to be eliminated.
Target eliminated. Payment authorized.
Artifact procurement: %s
Client %s (%s) requests a sample for analysis: %s. Find it and deliver it to HQ.
Our researchers need a specific artifact.
Sample received. The researchers will be pleased.
Rare samples: %s
The laboratory needs rare mutant tissue. Requested by %s (%s). Bring: %s.
The lab needs rare mutant tissue for analysis.
Rare samples received and paid for.
Biological samples: %s
Routine mutant tissue samples have been requested by %s (%s). Deliver: %s.
We need mutant tissue samples from the field.
Samples accepted. Payment issued.
Client %s (%s) requests medical supplies: %s.
The infirmary is restocked. Here is your pay.
The infirmary needs medical supplies.
Medical requisition: %s
Lost Knowledge
UNISG intelligence has located a stash containing classified research documents. Recover the documents and return them to the HQ trader.
We need classified research papers from a stash. Follow the coordinates, recover the documents and bring them here. Keep any other supplies you find.
Documents secured. Here is your payment.
